name: Google Play Services
description: Core component for Google APIs. Removing it will break many apps relying on Google services (e.g. Maps, Push Notifications).

name: Google Services Framework
description: Handles communications with Google servers. Required for Google Play and push notifications.

name: Google Play Store
description: The official app store for Android. You won't be able to install/update apps from Google if removed.

name: Google Play Services Extension
description: Provides core system functionalities for Google Play Services.

name: YouTube
description: Video streaming app. Can be safely removed and replaced with open-source alternatives like NewPipe.

name: Google Maps
description: Navigation app. Can be removed if you use alternatives like OsmAnd or Magic Earth.

name: Google Drive
description: Cloud storage app. Safe to remove.

name: Google Photos
description: Photo gallery app. Safe to remove.

name: Google App
description: Google Search and Assistant. Removing it will disable voice assistant and search widgets.

name: Facebook
description: Social media app with known tracking capabilities. Safe to remove.

name: Facebook System
description: Pre-installed Facebook background service. Safe to remove.

name: Facebook App Manager
description: Updates Facebook apps in the background. Safe to remove.

name: Facebook Services
description: Background service for Facebook. Safe to remove.

name: Samsung Bixby
description: Samsung's virtual assistant. Safe to remove.
